text.en:
Tariff Heading 76.04 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978 is hereby revised to read as
Aluminum foil (whether or not embossed, cut to shape, perforated, coated, printed or backed with paper or
other reinforcing material), of a thickness (excluding any backing) not exceeding 0.20 millimeter:
A. [Aluminum Reinforced Paper Packing Material]
ALUMINUM FOIL BACKED WITH WAXCOATED , PRINTED PAPER AND LAMINATED WITH
PLASTIC MATERIAL USED FOR PACKAGING LIQUID PRODUCTS, WHEN IMPORTED DIRECTLY
BY GOOD PROCESSORS. . . . . . . . Ad Val. 10%
B. Others . . . [Ad Val. 20%] . . . Ad. Val 30%

Repealing Clause Any and all acts, statutes, decrees, rules, regulations or parts thereof
inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 8th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty.
